decision: P6 (decided 16 Nov 2026 by Devansh): the documented run-as identity of the vulnerable process, cited (URL, retrieval date, SHA-256), else UNKNOWN; never inferred. Keys are '<pool product>|<family>'. Quotes are verbatim from the raw page with tags removed and whitespace collapsed. Admin-level principals (root, SYSTEM) give admin on the target; none is cited here.

Exchange|mail.reason: Microsoft's statements that Exchange application pools run as LocalSystem found by search cover Exchange 2007 only, not the 2013-SE builds in the catalogue

IIS|ftp.reason: no fetched Microsoft document states the FTP service's run-as identity

quotes: For every application pool you create, the Identity property of the new application pool is set to ApplicationPoolIdentity by default.

OpenSSH for Windows|ssh.reason: the fetched OpenSSH for Windows pages describe file ACLs for SYSTEM, not the identity sshd runs as (openssh_windows_*.html fetched)

Remote Desktop Services|rdp.reason: the NETWORK SERVICE statement found by search covers Windows Server 2008 only; no document for 2012 R2-2022 fetched

quotes: Default instance of the Database Engine service NT SERVICE\MSSQLSERVER

SQL Server|sql.process: SQL Server Database Engine service, default instance

Windows DNS Server|dns.reason: no current Microsoft document fetched states the DNS Server service logon account

Windows SMB server|smb.reason: no fetched Microsoft document states the SMB server's run-as identity

quotes: The User directive sets the user ID as which the server will answer requests.

apache:tomcat|http.reason: Tomcat runs as whatever account starts it; the security how-to only recommends a dedicated non-root user (tomcat_security_howto.html fetched)

crushftp:crushftp|ftp.reason: no vendor documentation of the service account found

dovecot:dovecot|mail.reason: Dovecot runs many processes under different users; the vulnerable process of a CVE cannot be pinned (dovecot_service_configuration.html fetched)

exim:exim|mail.reason: the Exim spec gives several identities (setuid root binary, Exim user for some processes); the SMTP receiving process of a remote CVE cannot be pinned to one without inference (exim_security.html fetched)

neutrinolabs:xrdp|rdp.reason: no fetched xrdp document states the daemon's run-as identity (xrdp_readme.md fetched)

quotes: If given, after binding the port the user privileges are dropped.

nlnetlabs:unbound|dns.process: unbound (the daemon after binding its port)

openbsd:openssh|ssh.reason: sshd(8) does not state the identity of the process a remote CVE hits (listener, privsep child, session) (openbsd_sshd.8.html fetched)

proftpd:proftpd|ftp.reason: the User directive page answered 404 (fetch log)

samba:samba|smb.reason: smbd(8) does not state the run-as identity of the serving process (smbd.8.html fetched)

quotes: Normally this user is "nobody" but that can be over-ridden with this switch.

wftpserver:wing_ftp_server|ftp.reason: no vendor documentation of the service account found
